newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian group offers 6.39 pct mortgage rate.
newsitem.headline: Australian group offers 6.39 pct mortgage rate.

text.p: Unlisted mortgage originator Wizard Financial Services Group said on Monday that it had lowered its no-frills variable mortgage rate by 50 basis points to 6.39 percent, effective immediately.

The group, which has its financing raised by two securitisers, Interstar Pty Ltd and the New South Wales state government affiliate FANMAC, said the reduction provided the full amount by which the Reserve Bank eased monetary policy late last month.
The central bank cut the official cash rate to 5.5 percent from six percent on May 23.
Of Australia's "Big Four" banks, only the Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd passed on the full cut in official cash, lowering its standard variable rate by 56 basis points to 6.99 percent.
This is the same rate as that set by the key mortgage originator, Aussie Home Loans.
The standard rates of the other big banks are set at 7.2 percent.
Wizard executive chairman Mark Bouris said the company expected to write more than A$31 million of new business in the month of June.
Bouris told Reuters that the company received a good margin on its current rate due to low overheads but believed there was not much more room to lower housing rates.
